informationOffice.address: OEC, PMI Auditorium Building Zero Point, Islamabad

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies OEC as Pakistan's EPS sending agency.

HRD Korea directly verifies 9th Point System pages for Islamabad and Karachi with registration 2026-03-31 through 2026-04-08, General CBT, Point System, while test announcement and test period remain undecided.
Those direct official page titles do not explicitly state Manufacturing, so KEP does not promote the city schedules as Manufacturing-specific without sector linkage.
A non-official schedule mirror lists a separate Pakistan 9th Manufacturing route with dates undecided; this remains discovery-only evidence.
HRD Korea pass-list index contains a Pakistan Special CBT result artifact published 2026-08-21; Special remains outside Regular Manufacturing.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use only a current Pakistan Manufacturing notice for complete eligibility. The verified 9th Point System city schedules do not explicitly identify Manufacturing in their public titles.

stages.title: 9th Point System registration
stages.action: HRD Korea directly verifies 9th Point System registration in Islamabad and Karachi from 2026-03-31 through 2026-04-08. KEP does not promote this as Manufacturing-specific until sector linkage is proven.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: No Pakistan Manufacturing cycle-specific fee is promoted until a direct official Manufacturing notice is captured.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only current Pakistan identity and anti-fraud requirements. Do not import another country's biometric steps.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The exact Pakistan Manufacturing passport/photo/upload/payment checklist remains HOLD until a direct current Manufacturing notice is captured.

stages.title: Test announcement / admission
stages.action: For the verified Islamabad and Karachi 9th Point System pages, the test-announcement date remains undecided. Do not invent a Manufacturing date.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Pakistan Manufacturing
stages.action: The verified Islamabad/Karachi 9th Point System pages are General CBT and Point System, but their public titles do not state Manufacturing. Manufacturing exact schedule remains gated.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: Do not infer a Pakistan Manufacturing skills schedule without a current sector-linked official artifact.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: No current Pakistan Manufacturing final-result artifact is promoted. Special EPS-TOPIK result evidence remains a separate route.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Pakistan psychology stage is asserted from the verified sources. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only current Pakistan EPS medical/provider guidance. Exact Manufacturing provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After verified Manufacturing final selection, follow current Pakistan candidate-file instructions. Exact documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates proceed to employer selection. Private intermediaries cannot guarantee roster priority or placement.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for selection through the official EPS system. No private intermediary can guarantee a specific Korean employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected, follow current official Pakistan/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Pakistan requirements
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa, payments and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current Pakistan/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact Manufacturing downstream details are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow current Pakistan instructions only if a final recheck is explicitly required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
